name: ListenMe
tagline: Listens to someone with aphasia describe a word they cannot find and offers it on screen.
problem: Many stroke survivors have anomic aphasia; therapy still relies on picture boards.
solution: Detects circumlocution in live speech with a multimodal model and suggests the intended word, logging struggles as clinical insight.
demo_moment: Team-described: say 'it's a red fruit you crunch' and see 'apple' appear.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Gemini API” among 169 submissions.

lessons: A precise clinical niche makes an LLM demo meaningful.
